content.title: 10 Million Durood Challenge: Day 1 Update
content.subtitle: Join millions of believers across the globe
content.body:
Alhamdulillah! Today marks the first day of our Durood campaign. So far, 3,393 devoted brothers and sisters from around the world have joined this blessed caravan. Through their heartfelt, tear-touched recitations, 623,107 Duroods have reached our beloved Prophet ﷺ in Madinah, achieving 6.23% of our 10 million goal. With 9 days remaining in this 10-day journey, can we unite in our love for the Prophet ﷺ to reach this monumental milestone?

Global Solidarity of the Ummah

This procession of devotion extends far beyond Bangladesh, crossing geographical borders to unite believers worldwide. Expatriate and local Muslims from Saudi Arabia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Japan, the United Arab Emirates, India, Qatar, Italy, and as far as Zimbabwe in Africa have joined this blessed cause. The global Ummah stands connected as one—have you joined this historic caravan yet?

A Grand Opportunity for Worship and Dawah

If you have not participated yet, do not delay—join right now. Share the campaign link with your family, friends, colleagues, and relatives, encouraging them to be part of this sacred effort. In sha Allah, through the ripple effect of your share, every Durood recited will bring an equal reward to your own scale of good deeds.

Let your gift of devotion reach the Rawdah in Madinah. Join the Campaign Now: https://campaign.muslimsday.com/durud-sept-26/bn
